findings.title: PublicOptions weakens the discriminated-union contract for scope/teamId
findings.body: InsightsBookingServicePublicOptions makes teamId optional for every scope, replacing the previous discriminated union in the constructor signature. A caller can now compile with scope: "team" and no teamId and will silently get the NOTHING_CONDITION (no insights data) instead of a compile-time error, and user/org callers can pass an irrelevant teamId that is silently ignored. Runtime zod validation still rejects the shape, but the exported type no longer documents or enforces the scope-specific requirements that callers previously got from InsightsBookingServiceOptions.
